chunks: Al-Hasan ibn 'Abdillah ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa narrated to me from his father 'Abdillah ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Isḥāq ibn 'Ammār, who said:

I heard Abā 'Abdillāh (peace be upon him) say, 'The location of the grave of Al-Ḥusayn ibn 'Ali (peace be upon him) has been a garden from the gardens of Paradise since the day he was buried in it.' And he said, 'The location of the grave of Al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him) is an oasis from the oases of Paradise.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual status of Imam Husayn's grave according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the burial site of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him) as a 'garden' (rawdah) and 'oasis' (tur'ah) of Paradise, a concept central to Shia hagiography that elevates the physical location of the shrine to a spiritual axis of the cosmos. This description underscores the theological significance of Ziyarat, where the grave serves not merely as a resting place but as a living conduit of divine grace and a tangible link to the afterlife, a theme deeply explored in the works of scholars like Ibn Qulawayh.
